name: Torvoneustes
sum: Marine metriorhynchid from the Late Jurassic and earliest Cretaceous of England, Switzerland and Mexico, 3.7 to 4.7 m long.
wsnote: T. coryphaeus 3.7 m, T. jurensis about 4 m, T. carpenteri 4–4.7 m, some specimens larger (Wikipedia).
holotype: A skull first assigned to Metriorhynchus superciliosus; postcranial remains were later found in the same quarry and the type species was first named in Dakosaurus.
material: Skull and postcranial remains from the Kimmeridge Clay of Dorset and Wiltshire, the Virgula Marls of Switzerland and Oaxaca, Mexico.
biology: Seen as a transitional form between long-snouted, fish-eating metriorhynchids and short-snouted hypercarnivores such as Dakosaurus.
author: Andrade et al. 2010
